title: Confidential Data Sent to Chinese AI Firm MiniMax Was Accessed Without Authorization, US Research Firm Identifies
title_en: Confidential Data Sent to Chinese AI Firm MiniMax Was Accessed Without Authorization, US Research Firm Identifies

inline_images.caption_en: Confidential Data Sent to Chinese AI Firm MiniMax Was Accessed Without Authorization, US Research Firm Identifies (Photo: REUTERS)

author: Reuters
content_snippet:
Confidential data sent to Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) startup MiniMax (0100.HK) was accessed by unidentified third parties, it has emerged. The finding was disclosed by HD Moore, chief research officer (CRO) of US cybersecurity firm Dragos, who said the access occurred even when users specified they did not want their data stored or retained.

In a blog post dated the 19th of this month, Dragos published research findings showing that private web links embedded in requests to AI service
summary_en: Dragos Chief Research Officer HD Moore revealed that AI startup MiniMax improperly stores private web links from user prompts despite opt-out requests. Security researchers observed unauthorized third-party access to these links, accompanied by suspicious traffic originating from Beijing, Shanghai, and the Moscow region, alongside attempts to exfiltrate private software code.
title_zh: MiniMax AI模型被曝存在数据隐私漏洞
summary_zh: 美资安公司Dragos调查发现，中国AI独角兽MiniMax的云服务存在用户隐私数据被第三方非法访问的重大风险

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国网络安全公司Dragos首席研究官HD Moore披露，AI创企MiniMax在处理用户请求时，即便用户明确拒绝数据留存，其后台仍会收集敏感URL链接。测试发现，这些私密链接遭未经授权的第三方非法访问，且伴随来自北京、上海及俄罗斯莫斯科地区的异常流量，甚至出现用户私有代码被尝试下载的迹象。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Dragos Chief Research Officer HD Moore revealed that AI startup MiniMax improperly stores private web links from user prompts despite opt-out requests. Security researchers observed unauthorized third-party access to these links, accompanied by suspicious traffic originating from Beijing, Shanghai, and the Moscow region, alongside attempts to exfiltrate private software code.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】MiniMax（AI大模型厂商）；HD Moore（Dragos首席研究官）在企业云服务后端与API调用接口：未经授权的数据留存、第三方非法访问用户私密链接与代码
【起因与机理】后端数据处理机制存在安全缺陷，未能有效执行用户隐私保护指令
【关键技术规格】MiniMax后端处理机制被发现会非法留存用户私密请求链接。
【各方立场与态度】隐私保护缺失可能引发跨国合规危机及云端部署信任崩塌。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] MiniMax; HD Moore, CRO of Dragos: Unauthorized data retention and third-party access to sensitive URLs and code
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Security flaws in data handling and non-compliance with privacy-preservation settings
[Key Fact Detail] MiniMax backend improperly retains private user request links.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Security flaws pose risks to cross-border compliance and cloud deployment trust.

author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet:
Tech experts are warning that a global memory chip shortage driven by technology giants is causing prices to soar for many consumer electronic products.

“All these AI data centres that are powering all these AI tools, they need huge amounts of RAM and they are basically gobbling it up right now,” said Mike Agerbo from GetConnected Media.

summary_en: Global memory chip supplies are tightening as tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Meta aggressively procure RAM for AI data center expansion. This shift has triggered a surge in consumer electronic manufacturing costs, with industry experts projecting significant retail price hikes and supply constraints lasting through 2027.
title_zh: AI基建挤占内存产能，消费电子成本攀升
summary_zh: 全球科技巨头对RAM需求激增，导致内存芯片供应紧缺，预计消费电子产品价格将在未来12至24个月内持续上涨

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 由于Google、Microsoft与Meta等科技巨头大规模采购RAM以支撑AI数据中心运行，全球内存芯片供应陷入短缺。该现象导致电子消费品制造端成本剧增，业内专家预计入门级笔记本电脑等产品售价将大幅上调，且产能紧张态势或持续至2027年。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Global memory chip supplies are tightening as tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Meta aggressively procure RAM for AI data center expansion. This shift has triggered a surge in consumer electronic manufacturing costs, with industry experts projecting significant retail price hikes and supply constraints lasting through 2027.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Google、Microsoft、Meta等科技巨头在全球内存芯片供应链：大量抢购RAM资源，导致消费电子市场供应短缺，成品价格预期增长超20%
【起因与机理】AI算力中心对高带宽内存与存力资源的极致消耗
【关键数据与实测】I think the $600 laptop and cheap desktop market has pretty much disappeared at this point,” he said.。
【各方立场与态度】RAM短缺局面预计持续至2027年。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Tech giants including Google, Microsoft, and Meta (Global semiconductor supply chain): Aggressive procurement of RAM causing shortage and projected 20%+ price increases for consumer electronics
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Explosive demand for RAM in AI data centers
[Key Metrics] I think the $600 laptop and cheap desktop market has pretty much disappeared at this point,” he said.
[Key Position & Outlook] Shortage anticipated to persist until 2027.

content_snippet:

Software shares have been relatively unscathed by this month’s brutal rout in the tech sector, which has been concentrated in the semiconductor stocks that until recently were investor darlings.

summary_en: Investors are rotating away from semiconductor dominance toward software firms possessing proprietary datasets and entrenched customer bases. Despite early 2026 sell-offs driven by fears of AI-driven obsolescence, the software sector now exhibits greater defensive value amidst broader tech market volatility.
title_zh: AI产业叙事反转，软件股抗跌性超半导体
summary_zh: 市场对AI价值链预期发生逆转，投资者减持芯片股并回流至具防御属性的软件板块

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 投资者正从过去追捧半导体硬件的逻辑中撤出，转而重估具备专有数据集壁垒与存量客户底座的软件企业。尽管2026年初软件股因担忧大模型替代效应出现抛售，但近期该板块在科技股抛售潮中展现出更强的防御价值。

Despite early 2026 sell-offs driven by fears of AI-driven obsolescence, the software sector now exhibits greater defensive value amidst broader tech market volatility.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】德意志银行、巴克莱资本、曼氏集团等机构投资者在全球资本市场科技板块：资本从半导体板块撤出并重新布局具有结构性竞争优势的软件公司
【起因与机理】AI红利预期从单纯的算力基础设施转向软件端的落地与护城河价值重构

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Shift in AI investment thesis from infrastructure-first to sustainable software application value
[Market & Financial Detail] Market sentiment shifting from AI hardware infrastructure to software application utility.
[Key Position & Outlook] Software firms with data moats and high retention re-emerging as structural winners.

title: Microsoft says state-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, have added AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their arsenals (Jonathan Greig/The Record)
title_en: Microsoft says state-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, have added AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their arsenals (Jonathan Greig/The Record)

inline_images.caption: Image: Angel Bena via Pexels
inline_images.alt: Image: Angel Bena via Pexels

author: The Record
content_snippet:
State-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea are using a powerful AI hacking tool in attacks, according to a new report from Microsoft.

Microsoft explained that state-sponsored and financially motivated hackers are using Artex, an AI-powered platform that can automate multiple phases of cyber intrusions at machine speed.

The study emerged hours after The New York Times and NextGov reported that Artex was allegedly used in attacks on the CIA, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
summary_en: Microsoft reports that state-sponsored hacking groups, including Salt Typhoon, have integrated the AI-powered penetration testing tool ARTEX into their offensive arsenals. By automating reconnaissance, credential theft, and vulnerability scanning, the tool compresses intrusion cycles to minutes while bypassing static signature detection via behavioral obfuscation.
title_zh: 中朝黑客组织引入AI自动化渗透工具ARTEX
summary_zh: 微软报告称受国家支持的黑客组织正利用名为ARTEX的AI工具实施网络攻击

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软揭露中国与朝鲜背景的黑客组织（包括Salt Typhoon等）已将AI驱动的渗透测试平台ARTEX集成至攻击套件中。该工具通过自动化侦察、凭据攻击及漏洞扫描，将攻击周期缩短至分钟级，并能通过行为混淆绕过签名检测。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Microsoft reports that state-sponsored hacking groups, including Salt Typhoon, have integrated the AI-powered penetration testing tool ARTEX into their offensive arsenals. By automating reconnaissance, credential theft, and vulnerability scanning, the tool compresses intrusion cycles to minutes while bypassing static signature detection via behavioral obfuscation.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】微软安全情报部门、Salt Typhoon、Crystal Typhoon等攻击组织在全球关键基础设施与电信领域：利用AI平台ARTEX实施自动化网络侦察与提权入侵
【起因与机理】AI技术的自动化特性可显著提升渗透效率并降低被传统防御系统监测的概率
【核心事实细节】ARTEX平台实现多阶段攻击的自动化，大幅缩短入侵时间。
【各方立场与态度】行为特征分析成为防御此类AI驱动型攻击的唯一可靠防线。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Microsoft Security Intelligence, Salt Typhoon, Crystal Typhoon: Utilization of the AI platform ARTEX for automated network reconnaissance and privileged access
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI-enabled automation significantly accelerates intrusion timelines and evades traditional signature-based detection
[Key Fact Detail] ARTEX enables multi-stage automated attacks, significantly compressing intrusion cycles.
[Key Position & Outlook] Behavioral analysis emerges as the only viable defense against AI-driven intrusion.

title: Nvidia halts chip shipments to south-east Asia
title_en: Nvidia halts chip shipments to south-east Asia
author: Zijing Wu
content_snippet:
Nvidia has told its manufacturing partners to stop shipping servers to four south-east Asian countries, as the US steps up export controls to prevent Chinese access to AI computing power.

Manufacturing partners such as Dell and Supermicro, which package Nvidia’s chips into servers, have told buyers in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia that Nvidia will not allow their orders to be shipped, according to three people with knowledge of the matter.

It is unclear whether the halt is tempor
summary_en: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners, including Dell and Supermicro, to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia to comply with new US export control regulations. This measure targets the loophole allowing Chinese AI developers to access restricted high-end GPU compute via local cloud providers, as firms struggle with the lack of specific compliance guidelines.
title_zh: 英伟达暂停向东南亚四国供应AI算力服务器
summary_zh: 英伟达指令戴尔与超微电脑等伙伴暂停向东南亚四国输送服务器，以配合美国最新的出口管制规则，防止中国开发者通过云端租赁获取高端芯片算力

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英伟达要求戴尔科技与超微电脑等制造伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国及印度尼西亚输送服务器，以应对美国商务部对AI算力输出的新规。此举旨在堵塞中国AI开发团队通过东南亚云服务商绕过美国制裁获取顶级GPU算力的漏洞，目前相关厂商正处于合规审计的静默期。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners, including Dell and Supermicro, to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia to comply with new US export control regulations. This measure targets the loophole allowing Chinese AI developers to access restricted high-end GPU compute via local cloud providers, as firms struggle with the lack of specific compliance guidelines.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达 (Nvidia)、戴尔科技 (Dell)、超微电脑 (Supermicro)、美国商务部在马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚：暂停服务器整机出口并执行合规排查，配合美国商务部的算力出口管制
【起因与机理】防止中国AI实体通过第三方云服务租赁绕过美方技术封锁
【关键数据与实测】涉案细节：英伟达及其代工伙伴戴尔、超微电脑已暂停向四国出货，正在等待美国商务部90天内的合规细则引导。
【行业影响与走向】行业影响：东南亚算力枢纽地位受损，云服务商面临严重的客户合规性验证压力。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Nvidia, Dell, Supermicro, US Department of Commerce: Halting server shipments and conducting compliance audits to adhere to new US compute export restrictions
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To prevent Chinese entities from bypassing sanctions via third-party cloud rental services
[Key Metrics] The chipmaker booked $104bn of revenue through its Singapore subsidiary in 2025, a 72 per cent increase in 12 months, according to company accounts.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Industry impact: SE Asian compute hubs face immediate supply chain disruption and high compliance verification costs.

title: Shein’s Slow India Start Lays Bare Limits of Billionaire Ambani’s Retail Might

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.'s return to India through a local partner is off to a slow start, due to supply chain snags …
summary_en: Shein Global Holdings Ltd. is struggling to gain traction in its return to the Indian market through a local partnership, hampered by supply chain bottlenecks and leadership instability. The platform has yet to replicate the proprietary technological edge that propelled its global operational efficiency.

summary_en: Investigations reveal that several California-based NVIDIA partners are effectively controlled by Chinese firms, with executives linked to Chinese military institutions and blacklisted entities. title: Amazon loses its latest attempt to get out of handling more recall notices

content_snippet:
Amazon is on the hook to recall more than 400,000 hazardous products after losing its legal battle against the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). The US District Court for the District of Maryland ruled in favor of the CPSC, which argued that Amazon is a distributor of goods, not a logistics provider, making it responsible for carrying out recalls of third-party products.

Amazon sued the CPSC in March 2025 after the agency ordered Amazon to recall over 400,000 “Fulfilled by Amazon” p

summary_en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Deputy Steve Feinberg explored invoking the 1950 Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. [Key Fact Detail] Administration officials explored the DPA to influence Nvidia's leadership.

The US is tightening its grip in the AI race with China, and the push is already having an effect, according to The Information. Chinese AI developers including Deepseek, Moonshot AI, and Alibaba have been under pressure since September, squeezed by restrictions on Chinese firms' remote access to advanced Nvidia chips in foreign data centers and by successful anti-distillation measures from OpenAI and Anthropic.

As North Korean cyberthieves were funneling billions out of Binance last month, the world’s largest crypto exchange looked to two other companies to help stop the bleeding: Tether and Circle.

title: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
title_en: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
Startup PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an updated version of its aggressively compressed language model. It's based on Qwen3.8-27B and takes up just 5.9 GB of memory, same as its predecessor. That's possible because of ternary quantization, where each weight can only be one of three values (−1, 0, or +1) instead of the usual 16-bit storage. At full precision, a model this size would need about 54 GB.

title_en: Asia Data Centers Sound Out US Clients to Replace China Demand

inline_images.caption: New US AI chip rules against China threaten Southeast Asia’s data centers
inline_images.alt: New US AI chip rules against China threaten Southeast Asia’s data centers

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
Washington has spent years stopping advanced AI chips from physically reaching China. It turns out the chips never had to travel at all.

On Monday, the US Commerce Department issued a rule aimed at Chinese companies that tap high-end AI hardware sitting in data centers outside China. The move lands hardest on Southeast Asia, a region that has been building server farms at a brisk clip.

The rule comes from the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, or BIS. It is an interim final
summary_en: The US Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued an interim final rule, effective around November 16, 2026, targeting remote access to high-end AI compute by Chinese entities at non-US data centers. Facilities providing significant compute, exceeding 12 million aggregate TPP, are required to implement enhanced due diligence and obtain licenses, facing potential trade restrictions for non-compliance.

summary_zh: 美商务部工业与安全局拟管制向中国实体提供远程算力的境外数据中心，涉及1200万TPP以上算力规模的合规监管

Facilities providing significant compute, exceeding 12 million aggregate TPP, are required to implement enhanced due diligence and obtain licenses, facing potential trade restrictions for non-compliance.

title: MIT team discovers that unrealistic training data makes AI climate predictions more reliable
title_en: MIT team discovers that unrealistic training data makes AI climate predictions more reliable
author: Manuel Uth
content_snippet:
MIT researchers have developed a method that makes training AI climate models faster, cheaper, and more reliable. According to MIT News, these emulators now need only a fraction of the data typically required.

summary_en: Researchers from MIT, ETH Zurich, and Imperial College London have developed a method to train AI climate emulators using synthetic data characterized by extreme environmental fluctuations, such as sudden CO2 spikes. This approach allows models to achieve high precision and robustness with only a single simulation run, significantly reducing computational demand.

This approach allows models to achieve high precision and robustness with only a single simulation run, significantly reducing computational demand.

[Key Position & Outlook] Enhanced model robustness for non-standard climate scenario prediction.

title: AI is straining America’s open records systems

author: Rachel Courtland
content_snippet:
In Panton, Vermont, population 660, town clerk Kyle Rowe did it all. He crafted budgets, paid vendors, handled property tax disputes, and served as the town’s zoning supervisor and presiding elections officer. During morning office hours at the town hall—a wood-frame structure built as a church in 1858—he also fielded public records requests. Recently, he got rather busy.

summary_en: AI-powered automation is triggering a surge in public records requests across the U.S., forcing local agencies to handle significantly increased volume and scope. author: Nikkei Asia
content_snippet:
TAIPEI -- China's Huawei Technologies and a local partner say they have overcome a U.S. crackdown on its use of advanced chip design tools, a market long dominated by American leaders Synopsys and Cadence, paving the way for the Chinese tech titan to design next-generation chips for phones and servers domestically.

Phlexing Technology, a little-known electronic design automation (EDA) software provider, said it has been partnering with Huawei to develop toolkits to design chips based on Huawei'
summary_en: Huawei and Phlexing Technology have collaborated since 2019 to integrate chip architecture, workflows, and EDA tools. Leveraging Huawei’s 'Tau Scaling Law,' the project aims to resolve automation challenges in advanced chip design, circumventing US-imposed Entity List restrictions.
title_zh: 华为携手飞昂科技构建国产EDA工具链
summary_zh: 华为自2019年起联合飞昂科技研发Tau EDA工具，旨在通过“Tau缩放定律”突破芯片设计领域的美方技术封锁

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 华为与国产EDA软件商飞昂科技（Phlexing）合作，深度整合芯片架构、设计流程及EDA工具链。该项目依托华为“Tau缩放定律”核心技术，旨在解决先进制程下芯片设计的全链路自动化难题，以此对抗美国对其实施的实体清单封锁。

title: Huawei says HarmonyOS has surpassed 100M installations across smartphones, tablets, and PCs, offering 460K+ apps and services from 12M+ registered developers (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
title_en: Huawei says HarmonyOS has surpassed 100M installations across smartphones, tablets, and PCs, offering 460K+ apps and services from 12M+ registered developers (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)

inline_images.caption: The logo of Huawei during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai on July 6, 2023. Photo: AFP
inline_images.alt: The logo of Huawei during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai on July 6, 2023.

author: South China Morning Post
content_snippet:
Huawei Technologies has announced that HarmonyOS, its home-grown, Android-free operating system, has surpassed 100 million installations, marking a milestone in its effort to build a software ecosystem independent of Google’s mobile services amid US-led sanctions.

The Shenzhen-based firm said the total was reached this month across smartphones, tablets and personal computers running HarmonyOS 5, 6 and 7. Its ecosystem now offered more than 460,000 apps and services from over 12 million register
summary_en: Huawei Technologies announced that HarmonyOS has surpassed 100 million installations across smartphones, tablets, and PCs, supported by over 460,000 apps and 12 million registered developers. Richard Yu Chengdong, Chairman of the Consumer Business Group, stated that the ecosystem has crossed a critical scale threshold, signaling the system's transition to a mature, self-reliant software platform independent of Google’s mobile services.
title_zh: 华为鸿蒙系统装机量突破一亿大关
summary_zh: 华为宣布鸿蒙系统装机量超1亿，拥有超46万应用服务与1200万注册开发者，生态规模进入成熟期

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 华为技术有限公司宣布鸿蒙系统（HarmonyOS）在智能手机、平板及个人电脑端的总装机量已突破1亿台，并拥有超过46万个应用及1200万注册开发者。华为消费者业务集团董事长余承东表示，该系统已跨越关键规模门槛，标志着华为在脱离谷歌移动服务（GMS）后，成功构建起具备商业成熟度与自主可控能力的软件生态系统。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Huawei Technologies announced that HarmonyOS has surpassed 100 million installations across smartphones, tablets, and PCs, supported by over 460,000 apps and 12 million registered developers. Richard Yu Chengdong, Chairman of the Consumer Business Group, stated that the ecosystem has crossed a critical scale threshold, signaling the system's transition to a mature, self-reliant software platform independent of Google’s mobile services.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】华为技术有限公司、华为消费者业务集团董事长余承东在中国市场与全球生态部署：HarmonyOS装机量突破1亿台，形成46万应用与1200万开发者的生态规模
【起因与机理】应对美国贸易限制，实现从芯片到操作系统全栈自主可控的战略目标
【关键数据与实测】系统生态跨越关键规模门槛，突破1亿装机量与1200万开发者壁垒。

[Key Metrics] System ecosystem hits critical scale with 100M+ installations and 12M+ developers.

author: Nikkei Asia
content_snippet:

Samsung and SK Hynix have been exploring stacking technologies for 3D NAND flash memory and, through cross-licensing deals, agreed t
summary_en: Global memory leaders Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have integrated Yangtze Memory Technologies Co.'s (YMTC) Xtacking architecture via cross-licensing deals, utilizing independent CMOS and cell wafer bonding to optimize 3D NAND performance. This adoption confirms YMTC’s rapid technical maturation and patent portfolio depth, marking a significant milestone in China's semiconductor industrial self-sufficiency.

This adoption confirms YMTC’s rapid technical maturation and patent portfolio depth, marking a significant milestone in China's semiconductor industrial self-sufficiency.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】三星电子、SK海力士、长江存储（YMTC）在全球存储半导体产业供应链：通过交叉许可协议采纳Xtacking 3D NAND堆叠技术

[Key Fact Detail] Samsung and SK Hynix adopt Xtacking via cross-licensing agreements.

title: Amazon Targets UK Car Buyers Being Reeled In by Chinese Brands
title_en: Amazon Targets UK Car Buyers Being Reeled In by Chinese Brands
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Amazon.com Inc. will soon offer cars on its platform in the UK, joining an increasingly crowded British auto market where Chinese brands are winning over consumers.
summary_en: Amazon.com Inc. has announced plans to launch online car retail services in the UK by early 2027. This expansion builds upon its established US footprint, where it currently facilitates new and used car sales across 35 brands in over 150 cities, signaling a push to capture automotive market share through e-commerce channels.

title: ‘Tech bros strike back’ as Donald Trump rescues Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
title_en: ‘Tech bros strike back’ as Donald Trump rescues Nvidia’s Jensen Huang

author: Joe Miller, Alex Rogers, Ella Lee, Claire Jones, and George Hammond
content_snippet: Silicon Valley elites flexed their muscles in Washington to back Nvidia boss after humbling midterms defeat.
summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been reinstated after Silicon Valley investors, including Marc Andreessen, lobbied Vice President JD Vance and President Trump. Despite national security concerns raised by Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding alleged spy ties, Trump prioritized the AI-led economic boom and tech market stability, supported by Attorney General Todd Blanche’s confirmation of no evidence of wrongdoing.
title_zh: 黄仁勋重返英伟达CEO之职
summary_zh: 在硅谷投资人游说及美国总统特朗普干预下，黄仁勋在身陷安全调查后重回英伟达首席执行官职位

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在面临被指控与间谍关联的调查背景下，通过硅谷顶级投资人（包括Marc Andreessen等）对美国副总统JD Vance及总统特朗普的直接游说成功复职。尽管国务卿Marco Rubio等官员对国家安全隐患表达严重关切，但特朗普基于科技股暴跌及AI经济维稳的迫切诉求，最终推翻了情报机构意见，由司法部长Todd Blanche确认目前缺乏违法证据，以此促成其重回岗位。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been reinstated after Silicon Valley investors, including Marc Andreessen, lobbied Vice President JD Vance and President Trump. Despite national security concerns raised by Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding alleged spy ties, Trump prioritized the AI-led economic boom and tech market stability, supported by Attorney General Todd Blanche’s confirmation of no evidence of wrongdoing.

content_snippet:

Nov 24 (Reuters) – Dell Technologies on Tuesday raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year after record quarterly results, fueled by soaring enterprise demand for AI infrastructure.

Shares of Dell were up about 5% in extended trading after the company’s board also approved an additional $25 billion share repurchase plan.

The Texas-based company has been benefiting from the generative AI boom, as more businesses and cloud providers are buying Dell’s AI servers,
summary_en: Dell Technologies has raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year, fueled by record demand for AI infrastructure, with fiscal 2027 revenue now projected at $202 billion.
